annotation.evidence_span: other representation header fields beyond those required
annotation.interpretation_a: The sender should not generate any representation header fields beyond those required for a 206 response (i.e., the minimal set of headers defined for 206 responses).
annotation.interpretation_b: The sender should not generate any representation header fields beyond those required for a 200 response (i.e., the full set of headers that would have been sent in a 200 response).
annotation.justification: The clause references 'those required' without defining the set of required headers, leaving implementers uncertain whether to include only the minimal set for 206 responses or to preserve all headers from the prior 200 response. This missing definition creates a concrete ambiguity that can lead to materially different behaviours.
annotation.missing_information: Definition of the set of 'required representation header fields' in the context of a 206 response is not provided in the clause, leading to ambiguity about which headers may be omitted or must be included. This missing constraint prevents a unique operational interpretation. The clause also does not clarify whether the required headers refer to those in the prior response or to the minimal set for 206 responses. This lack of specification creates two materially different implementation behaviours. The ambiguity is therefore due to an incomplete constraint affecting implementation behaviour (U-2).
